name: OC Session Guard
description: Session bloat, idle admission guard & tool result hygiene — strips bloat fields, purges stale subagents, blocks idle model calls, truncates oversized tool outputs, and collapses poll loops.

suppressIdleHeartbeats.description: Block automated heartbeat turns when no actionable tasks are due to prevent idle model calls

headChars.description: Number of characters to preserve from the head of tool outputs

tailChars.description: Number of characters to preserve from the tail of tool outputs

maxToolResultChars.description: Max threshold before truncating tool outputs

enablePollDeduplication.description: Enable collapse and suppression of zero-delta poll frames
